source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1961, p. 10 ("Urban and borough election results"); Larne Times, 25 May 1961, p. 5 ("Borough of Larne: notice of result of election")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: read on the page image of the returning officer's notice (Larne Times 25 May 1961 p. 5): Gardenmore, Bawn Mrs. Molly W. 651, McKeever Thomas D. 874 elected, McKnight William 758 elected, Ringland Alfred T. P. 721; BNL 18 May 1961 p. 10 says McKeever and Mrs. Bawn stood as Independents.

note: Election of the ten Larne Borough councillors, two for each of the five wards, polled Wednesday 17 May 1961 in Gardenmore Ward only (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1961, p. 10). Central was uncontested after W. S. McIlroy withdrew; Inver and Townparks had two nominations each; Curran had one, the other seat becoming a casual vacancy filled at a later election (Larne Times, 4, 11 and 25 May 1961). No party labels are printed for the unopposed members. The defeated candidates' votes (Ringland 721, the sitting member Mrs. Molly W. Bawn, who stood as an Independent, 651) are from the returning officer's notice of result (Larne Times, 25 May 1961, p. 5). The other wards were uncontested and are not itemised. Estimated poll 60 per cent.
